text:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — Richmond QBR is Tue 4/9 10:00am PT. Need final exec deck + a 10‑minute health readout. Please upload slides to GDrive and drop link here. :spiral_calendar:
Tom Reyes: I'll own the usage + latency slides. Draft path: `slides/richmond/qbr_v1.pptx`. Aiming Fri EOD for draft.
Priya Singh: I'll take renewal-risk + enablement outcomes. Pulling latest health score, onboarding cadence, and survey highlights. Any specific asks from AEs?
Aisha Patel: @Priya loop in AE for a 30-day success ask and any customer quotes. Also call out recent adoption regressions on the risk slide.
Marco Alvarez: Proposal: dry-run Mon 4/8 11:00–11:20am PT, timeboxed. I'll chair and run Q&A rehearse. Can we confirm?
Liam O'Connor: I'll prepare a 1‑page exec brief with top 3 risks and proposed mitigations, plus one backup slide with metrics. Putting notes under slide 3.
cs-bot: Reminder: QBR slide deadline in 48h. Please upload to `#qbr-uploads` or GDrive to avoid last-minute pain.
Tom Reyes: Uploaded draft v0.1 to the drive and added speaker notes. Kept bullets tight and numbers only. :white_check_mark:
Priya Singh: Pasted the customer survey snippets into the notes and flagged onboarding gap that correlates with paid feature adoption drop. Marking as high-priority risk.
Aisha Patel: Action items recap: 1) Tom — finalize slides + testimonial, 2) Priya — finalize risk mitigation + 90-day plan, 3) Liam — exec 1‑pager, 4) Marco — confirm dry-run invite. I'll compile the tracker after lunch.
Marco Alvarez: Dry-run confirmed and calendar invites sent to execs, AE, and presenters. Meeting title: "Richmond QBR — Dry Run". :calendar:
Liam O'Connor: Added the exec bullets and a fallback talking point if they ask about latency spikes. Also attached a short rollback plan in notes.
Priya Singh: Linked the enablement playbook `playbooks/richmond_onboarding.md` and a short checklist for the customer success team.
Aisha Patel: One more: who is grabbing the customer quote/testimonial slide? @Tom or @Priya?
Tom Reyes: I'll request the quote from the AE and add it to slide 5. ETA Fri noon.
Aisha Patel: Great — thanks everyone. I'll post the consolidated action tracker here once I collate updates. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:
